wikipedia#11.title: 1863: American Civil War: Union forces captured Lookout Mountain, helping them break the Confederate siege of Chattanooga, Tennessee.

wikipedia#12.title: 1859: British naturalist Charles Darwin's On the Origin of Species was first published, and sold out its initial print run on the first day.

wikipedia#13.title: 1643: Thirty Years' War: Holy Roman Empire, Bavarian and Spanish forces led by Franz von Mercy defeated the French army in Germany led by Marshal Josias von Rantzau at the Battle of Tuttlingen.

wikipedia#14.title: 1542: Anglo-Scottish Wars: English forces captured about 1,200 Scots at the Battle of Solway Moss.

wikipedia#15.title: 1221: Mongol invasion of the Khwarazmian Empire: Genghis Khan defeated Khwarazmian prince Jalal al-Din in the Battle of the Indus.
